novelty_flags.label: prop:published-tree-boundary
novelty_flags.one_line: Gupta--Bläser Theorem 27 proves the per-parameter 1/2/infinite classification, but it does not state the asserted exact maxima D_0(2)=D_0(3)=1 and D_0(n)=2 for every n≥4, so these cannot be called its direct corollary without a separate construction and derivation.

soundness_flags.label: thm:exceptional-set-validity; thm:real-root-lifting; thm:regular-finite-set-inference; prop:singleton-inference
soundness_flags.one_line: These nodes evaluate p_e and define E_{G,e}, but p_e is defined only when d_e(G)<∞; add this finite-coordinate-degree premise throughout the exceptional-set, lifting, and inference layer.

soundness_flags.label: ass:positive-noise
soundness_flags.one_line: For a real lift with Σ≻0, Ω=(I−Λ)^TΣ(I−Λ) is positive definite by congruence, exactly as the lifting theorem concludes, so this assumption is not independently needed there.

soundness_flags.label: ass:root-separation
soundness_flags.one_line: On the compact denominator-controlled class, the monic finite-degree p_e has uniformly bounded roots, and the uniform lower derivative bound implies a positive pairwise root-separation constant; retain γ as derived notation or drop the separate assumption.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:regular-finite-set-inference
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The statistical claim is conditional on fixed G and a compact smooth regular stratum away from the exceptional locus, with simple roots and locally stable real-lift labels.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The root-m Hausdorff rate, joint limit, and simultaneous coverage are claimed only uniformly over the stated regular class K_G, not across discriminants or branch collisions.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add d_e(G)<∞ explicitly to the certificate, exceptional-set, real-lifting, and inference domains; specify what the algorithm returns in the transcendental case without invoking p_e.
Replace Proposition 1 by the accurately cited Gupta--Bläser upper/trichotomy boundary, then separately give and prove explicit n=2,3 and n≥4 tree witnesses if the D_0 maxima are needed.
Minimize the regularity package: derive γ from compactness, bounded rational coefficients, and the simple-root derivative margin, and remove positive-noise as an antecedent of the lifting theorem.
Promote the sharp frontier to a stronger field result by supplying a worked nontrivial small-k coordinate eliminant that validates branch separation before relying on the all-size recurrence.
